rows.grounds: First member of compound qualifying 'jagatāṃ'; denotes totality.
Dependent on 'māthaḥ'; refers to the worlds collectively.
From root math/manth 'to churn'; agentive sense in relation to 'samasta-jagatāṃ'; exact nuance uncertain without wider context.
Indeclinable emphasizing immediate or manifest identity/presence.
Divine name; subject identified as Nārāyaṇa per Vaiṣṇava context.
